subject: a repaired defect that had no recurrence test

detail.found_by: writing receipts/po03/2026-08-22/producer-execution.json, which required naming the regression test for every repaired defect
detail.defect: The base-resolution repair recorded in event 0005 was verified only by running the four resolution branches by hand. No committed test would have caught a reintroduction, so a lesson was being reported as tested when it was not.
detail.repair: Two real tests were added: test_wrong_diff_base_charges_the_wave_for_pre_existing_paths reproduces the failure on real git history in a throwaway repository, and test_ci_workflow_prefers_the_po03_base_ref_over_main asserts the workflow keeps the corrected ordering.
secondary_repairs: workstreams/po03/tests/test_control_evidence.py::CitedTestsExistTests now also scans receipts/po03/**/*.json and workstreams/po03/control/events/*.json, so a receipt may not cite a test that does not exist.
workstreams/po03/tests/test_control_evidence.py::AcceptanceRequestTests was added so the acceptance request cannot mistally its own verdicts, skip a frozen control or cite a missing evidence path.
detail.note: The verdict tally in the first draft of the acceptance request was wrong. The test that now guards it was written because of that error, not before it.
